bead.title: Hybrid-async perf harness: pinned distributions, cache states, sweeps, scale matrix, reps
bead.description:
PROBLEM: The hybrid-async perf suite pushes one uniform payload string through a single sequential producer/consumer at one resident count and one repetition, so it cannot emit release-grade evidence across scale, cache state, concurrency, or workload shape.
ROOT CAUSE: spec() at crates/pqueue-server/tests/performance_object_log_hybrid_tests.rs:92 hardcodes the payload with no size/key/retry/error distribution; exercise_profile at crates/pqueue-server/tests/performance_object_log_hybrid_tests.rs:183 is a single sequential loop with no concurrency or cache-state control; run_suite at crates/pqueue-server/tests/performance_object_log_hybrid_tests.rs:669 reads one PQUEUE_HYBRID_RESIDENT and runs each backend once with no repetitions.
PROPOSED FIX: (a) add a deterministic seeded workload generator (seed=0, documented in docs/perf) driving spec() with pinned payload-size, client_item_key cardinality, retry-injection, and error-injection distributions; (b) add warm-cache (projection pre-touched) vs cold-cache (fresh backend open) run variants; (c) sweep concurrency via N tokio producer/consumer tasks (new PQUEUE_HYBRID_CONCURRENCY) and load/claim batch via existing *_BATCH env vars, emitting one ProfileRun per (cache,concurrency,batch) cell; (d) parametrize resident across {10000,100000,1000000,10000000} gated by an RSS/capacity guard that skips-with-log any scale exceeding the machine budget; (e) run >=5 repetitions per release cell and record median plus coefficient-of-variation with a documented outlier-trim policy.
NON-SCOPE: the hot-path performance fix (child 'Close hybrid-async hot-path gap'); bounded-debt/segment/attribution gates (child 'Hybrid-async perf gates + profile attribution'); running the release matrix and emitting final docs (child 'Emit release-grade hybrid-async evidence'); release version bump.
GATE SUBSTITUTION: this is a Rust/cargo crate with no go.mod or lefthook; the 'go test' gate is `cargo test -p pqueue-server` and the 'lefthook' pre-commit gate is `cargo fmt --check`.
bead.acceptance:
1. New Test performance_object_log_hybrid_distribution_pins asserts the seeded generator produces identical payload-size/key/retry/error sequences across two runs and non-uniform payload sizes: `cargo test -p pqueue-server --release --test performance_object_log_hybrid_tests performance_object_log_hybrid_distribution_pins -- --nocapture`.
2. New Test performance_object_log_hybrid_cache_matrix_smoke runs warm and cold cache variants plus a >=2-way concurrency/batch sweep at resident<=1000 and emits one ledger cell per (cache,concurrency,batch): `cargo test -p pqueue-server --release --test performance_object_log_hybrid_tests performance_object_log_hybrid_cache_matrix_smoke -- --nocapture`.
3. New Test performance_object_log_hybrid_scale_matrix parametrizes resident over {10k,100k,1M,10M}, skips-with-log any scale over the capacity guard, and runs >=5 reps per release cell recording median+CoV+outlier-trim fields: `cargo test -p pqueue-server --release --test performance_object_log_hybrid_tests performance_object_log_hybrid_scale_matrix -- --nocapture`.
4. Existing Test performance_object_log_hybrid_smoke still passes: `PQUEUE_LEDGER_DIR=docs/perf/evidence cargo test -p pqueue-server --release --test performance_object_log_hybrid_tests performance_object_log_hybrid_smoke -- --nocapture`.
5. `cargo fmt --check` passes.
